items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
notes: No disclosure of pecuniary interest was declared by any member of Council at this point in the meeting.

items.title: Territorial Acknowledgement
notes: Mayor McCabe opened the meeting with the following Territorial Acknowledgement:

We would like to begin by acknowledging that the land on which we gather (land on which we are broadcasting from) today is the land traditionally cared for by the Haudenosaunee, Anishinaabe and Chonnontan People. We also acknowledge the enduring presence and deep traditional knowledge and philosophies of the Indigenous People with whom we share this land today.

Sisters in Spirit Day honours missing and murdered Indigenous women, girls, two-spirit and gender-diverse people, while recognizing the strength and resilience of their families, loved ones and communities.

Today, we remember those who have been taken too soon and acknowledge the profound grief carried by families and communities across the country. We hold space for all those mourning the loss of mothers, daughters, sisters, grandmothers, aunties, cousins, friends and loved ones.
As we remember those lost, we also commit to action through improving Indigenous relations, fostering reconciliation and amplifying Indigenous voices to ensure safety and equity for all.

items.title: Moment of Reflection
notes: Mayor McCabe provided Council with a moment of reflection.
At the beginning of this Council meeting, we pause to think about the needs of our community. May we show wisdom and compassion in all our decisions.

notes: Mayor McCabe reminded Council that Councillor Freeman declared a conflict with respect to item 12a) Official Plan Amendment No. 56 and Zoning By-law Amendment Z-24-08, Northfield Equities Inc., 170-200 Northfield Drive West and 570-655 Weber Street North due to a conflict of interest as it relates to place of employment.

items.title: Official Plan Amendment No. 56 and
notes: Aminu Bello gave a presentation with an overview of the proposed development, including the difference between the initial renderings presented at the Informal Meeting and now. He then responded to questions of Council. Tim Anderson also responded to questions of Council.

Trevor Hawkins, MHBC Planning gave a presentation further detailing the proposed development, noting that the proposal could evolve over time depending on the needs of the site. He then responded to questions of Council.
As no one else was present to speak to the application, the Chair concluded the Formal Public Meeting and advised the application is now open to Council for a motion and debate.

items.title: New Business
notes: Councillor Hanmer gave a shoutout for the 25th Anniversary of the Waterloo Girls’ Minor Hockey Association.
Mayor McCabe mentioned the Nigerians in the Region of Waterloo also held their event, INDEFEST, on October 3 at RIM Park.
Councillor Vasic gave a shoutout to Johnny Fresco for their 20th Anniversary.
Councillor Vasic also mentioned the Creative Aging Expo happening on October 7 at Waterloo Public Library.
Councillor Wright wanted to promote two calls for artists: the bike locker wraps and the Waterloo Park Art Walk are both looking for submissions.
Councillor Roach mentioned that the Rolling Hills Neighbourhood Friendsgiving is this Saturday, October 10 at 3:00 p.m.
Councillor Roe thanked Kevin Van Ooteghem and Tiffany Smith for visiting Adventure4Change.
Mayor McCabe reminded everyone of the upcoming municipal election on October 26, and how Council is changing with the departure of Councillor Bodaly and Councillor Vasic.
